Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. About 30 minutes before the roast is finished, prepare the mashed potatoes. To assemble, add a bed of mashed potatoes to a plate, then top with the roast, potatoes, and carrots. Finish with some of the broth and fresh or dried parsley. Enjoy! 🤎 #fall #fallrecipes #potroast #cozyvibes #fallvibes

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Arayes 🥙 This is one of the best Mediterranean meals you can easily make at home in about 30 minutes. Crispy pita stuffed with seasoned beef, cooked until golden, and finished with a creamy garlic sauce. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more weeknight staples. Ingredients Meat Mixture • 1 lb ground beef (85/15) • 1 small yellow onion, grated and squeezed dry • 5 garlic cloves, finely grated • 1 grated jalapeño • 2 tbsp tomato paste • ⅓ cup parsley, finely chopped • ¼ cup cilantro, finely chopped • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tbsp ice water • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp cumin • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp allspice • 1 tsp coriander • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp cinnamon Other • 4 pitas, cut in half Garlic Tahini Yogurt Sauce • ¾ cup Greek yogurt • ¼ cup tahini • 3 garlic cloves, finely grated • Juice of ½ lemon • 1 tbsp olive oil • ½ tsp salt • ¼ tsp cumin • 2 tbsp parsley, finely chopped • 2 tbsp cilantro, finely chopped Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. In a large bowl, mix together the beef, grated onion, garlic, jalapeño, tomato paste, parsley, cilantro, olive oil, ice water, and spices until fully combined and slightly sticky. 3. Cut the pitas in half and gently open each pocket (heat the pitas in the microwave for a few seconds first to make them easier to open). Spread a thin layer of the meat mixture inside each pita, then brush the outside generously with olive oil. 4. Heat a pan over medium heat. Cook the arayes meat side down first for 1–2 minutes until charred, then flip and cook each pita side until golden and crispy. 5. Finish in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the meat reaches 155°F internally. 6. While the arayes cook, mix together all sauce ingredients until smooth. 7. Brush the hot arayes with olive oil mixed with minced garlic and parsley, then serve with the dipping sauce. #easydinners #arayes #pita

MARRY ME MASH 🥔✨ Recipe below ⬇️ This is the ultimate recipe for luxurious mashed potato. Ultra-smooth, buttery, garlic-thyme infused, finished with white pepper and nutmeg. Make no mistake - this is pure indulgence, and it will make your guests so silent at the table. Marry Me Mash: Peel and cube 1kg Maris Piper potatoes. Add to cold salted water, bring to the boil, then simmer gently until completely tender. Drain and leave to steam dry for 20-30 minutes (this step is key for texture). Meanwhile, gently simmer 200ml whole milk and 200ml double cream with 4 chopped garlic cloves and 3-4 thyme sprigs for 30 minutes to infuse. Strain and keep warm. Pass the dried potatoes through a ricer, then fold through 150g melted butter. For extra smoothness, push through a fine mesh sieve. Add the warm infused cream one ladle at a time until silky and smooth but still holding its shape. Season with fine salt, white pepper and a small grating of nutmeg. Taste and adjust. Bonus recipe - Braised Short Rib (perfect with this mash): Season 3-4 large beef short ribs generously with salt and pepper and sear in a hot casserole pot with 1 tbsp oil until deeply browned. Remove. In the same pot soften 1 diced onion, 2 diced celery sticks and 2 diced carrots. Add 2 tbsp tomato purée, 3 sliced garlic cloves, 3 thyme sprigs and 2 bay leaves. Deglaze with 500ml red wine, reduce slightly, then add enough beef stock (around 750ml-1L) to fully submerge the ribs. Return the ribs, cover and cook at 130°C for 4 hours until spoon tender. Remove the ribs, strain and remove the fat from the sauce (use a separator jug if you have one). Pass through a fine sieve and then reduce it until glossy and thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Return the ribs to the sauce and baste. Silky mash. Sticky, rich beef. MEATBALL SUB BITES! Homemade meatballs tossed in pizza sauce, then wrapped up in pizza dough with mozzarella and baked until golden brown, then brushed with butter, parm & parsley. And warm pizza sauce for dipping. It’s game day season and these are the perfect 2-bite app that we’re 100% sure everyone will love!!  Full recipe at: https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/meatball-sub-bites/ 1 lb 80/20 ground beef ½ cup Italian-seasoned breadcrumbs ½ cup whole milk 1 large egg ⅓ cup grated parmesan cheese 2 garlic cloves grated ¾ teaspoon kosher salt ½ teaspoon black pepper 8 ounces pizza dough 12 ounces pizza sauce divided ½ cup low-moisture mozzarella shredded 2 tablespoons melted butter for brushing Grated parmesan for topping Chopped parsley for topping Preheat your oven to 425˚F. To a small mixing bowl, add the breadcrumbs and milk together, stir, and let the mixture rest for five minutes. It should look like thick oatmeal, so add milk a tablespoon at a time if it looks dry. To a large mixing bowl, add the ground beef, panade, egg, parmesan, garlic, salt, and pepper. Mix gently by hand just until combined. Using a 3 tablespoon scoop, scoop into 14 meatballs and roll them into shape. Bake the meatballs 425°F for about 15 minutes. Slightly underbaked is fine; they'll be going back into the oven later. Toss the meatballs in about 4 ounces of the pizza sauce, setting the other half of the sauce aside for dipping later. They should be coated, not drenched. Cut the dough. Roll to ~12×10" and cut into squares. Grease a muffin tin. To make one of the meatball sub bites, add a square of pizza dough into one of the muffin slots, then place a pinch of shredded mozzarella on the bottom, a saucy meatball on top, and a pinch more mozzarella over it. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened. Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley. Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly. Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Avoid high heat so the tortilla doesn't brown before the cheese melts.
